verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a stakeholder dashboard that shows all of an employee's holdings across companies, lets them accept grants by e-signature, and lets them track vesting schedules and option values. Admins can preview this dashboard, and employees can exercise options through the platform. However, there is no evidence of exit or outcome scenario modeling, and an update FAQ indicates customers are being moved to other cap-table providers, which casts doubt on the portal's ongoing availability. Missing for 10: modeling what equity is worth under different outcomes, explicit display of strike price, confirmation the equity product is still offered, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the employee portal.
